basis.governing_question: Which new point-of-sale system should Farmácias Lusas choose, and how can it be rolled out to all 40 pharmacies?

sub_questions.question: What must a new point-of-sale system do for Farmácias Lusas' pharmacies, and where does the current system fall short?
Which point-of-sale system best meets the requirements, and does its business case hold?
How should the chosen system be configured, tested and proven at a pilot pharmacy?
In what waves does the new system reach all 40 pharmacies and run in each?

work.unit: Process area mapped with its requirements

phase_work.why: Four process areas mapped two at a time, with stakeholder interviews running alongside; within the typical 3 to 6 weeks.
One shortlist, demonstration and scoring round; no formal tender assumed. Within the typical 4 to 8 weeks.

work.unit: Packaged system for one process configured and tested
Rollout wave of up to 10 sites

phase_work.why: Configuration, migration rehearsal and one pilot pharmacy run in sequence, then four rollout waves of up to 10 pharmacies one after another.

sizing.levers: Running two rollout waves side by side would save 4 to 6 weeks; mapping fewer process areas would shorten Diagnostic.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Define the business requirements and process fit the new point-of-sale system must meet across the pharmacies.

gate.label: Requirements sign-off
gate.decision: Go on vendor selection with these requirements as the scoring basis?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Compare shortlisted point-of-sale vendors against the requirements and prepare the selection decision with a business case.

gate.label: Vendor selection
gate.decision: Which vendor goes forward to configuration and rollout?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Configure the chosen system, prove it at one pharmacy, then roll it out in waves to all 40 pharmacies.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the new system running in all 40 pharmacies as the final result?

architect_notes: Length is not given: the 27 to 33 weeks are an estimate, with Implementation set at the middle of its 16 to 24 weeks.
Implementation reaches 24 weeks if every step takes its longest time, chiefly 3 weeks for each of four rollout waves.
Four process areas in Diagnostic are assumed; each extra pair adds 1 to 2 weeks to Diagnostic. Confirm the count with the client.
No formal tender is planned in Design; if the contract must be tendered, Design grows by 4 to 6 weeks.
